description: This file defines the TraceUtils utility class for tracing HTTP requests, AMQP commands, and authentication filters by creating and returning configured ExpiringTimerBuilder instances with specific tags and metrics.

classes.name: TraceUtils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for generating tracing timers for HTTP requests, AMQP commands, and auth filters, with methods to process and tag trace information.

methods.name: newHttpRoundTripTimer
methods.description: Creates an expiring timer for HTTP round-trip, extracting request method and path to generate trace tags.

methods.name: newAmqpRoundTripTimer
methods.description: Creates an expiring timer for AMQP round-trip based on Command or Signal objects, adding relevant command tags.

methods.name: newAuthFilterTimer
methods.description: Creates an expiring timer for authentication filters, extracting trace information from HttpRequest or using provided tags.

methods.name: metricizeTraceUri
methods.description: Sanitizes a trace URI to be compatible as a metric name by replacing invalid characters.
